title: Rosmarinic acid mitigates chlorpyrifos-induced oxidative stress, inflammation, and kidney injury in rats by modulating SIRT1 and Nrf2/HO-1 signaling.
authors: Abduh, Maisa Siddiq; Alruhaimi, Reem S; Alqhtani, Haifa A; Hussein, Omnia E; Abukhalil, Mohammad H; Kamel, Emadeldin M; Mahmoud, Ayman M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究迷迭香酸对毒死蜱诱导大鼠肾损伤的保护作用，涉及氧化应激和SIRT1/Nrf2信号通路，仅含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chlorpyrifos (CPF) is a widely used broad-spectrum pesticide with multi-organ toxic effects. Oxidative stress was found to play a role in the deleterious effects of CPF, including nephrotoxicity. This study investigated the protective effect of the antioxidant polyphenol rosmarinic acid (RA) against CPF-induced kidney injury, with an emphasis on oxidative injury, inflammation, SIRT1, and Nrf2/HO-1 signaling. Rats received 10 mg/kg CPF and 25, 50, and 100 mg/kg RA orally for 28 days, and the samples were collected for analysis. CPF increased serum urea and creatinine and kidney Kim-1 and caused several histopathological alterations. ROS, MDA, NO, NF-kappaB p65, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta were elevated in the kidney of CPF-intoxicated rats. RA ameliorated kidney function markers, prevented tissue injury, suppressed ROS, MDA, and NO, and downregulated NF-kappaB p65, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta in CPF-intoxicated rats in a dose-dependent manner. RA decreased Bax, caspase-3, oxidative DNA damage, and Keap1, boosted antioxidant enzymes and Bcl-2, and upregulated Nrf2, HO-1, and SIRT1 in CPF-administered rats. Molecular docking simulation revealed the binding affinity of RA toward NF-kappaB, Keap1, HO-1, and SIRT1. In conclusion, RA prevented CPF nephrotoxicity by attenuating oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis and upregulating SIRT1 and Nrf2/HO-1 signaling.
abstract_zh: 毒死蜱（Chlorpyrifos, CPF）是一种广泛使用的广谱农药，具有多器官毒性作用。研究发现氧化应激在CPF的有害效应中发挥作用，包括肾毒性。本研究探讨了抗氧化多酚迷迭香酸（rosmarinic acid, RA）对CPF诱导的肾损伤的保护作用，重点研究氧化损伤、炎症、SIRT1及Nrf2/HO-1信号通路。大鼠口服给予10 mg/kg CPF及25、50和100 mg/kg RA，持续28天，并收集样本进行分析。CPF增加了血清尿素、肌酐及肾脏Kim-1水平，并引起多种组织病理学改变。在CPF中毒大鼠的肾脏中，ROS、MDA、NO、NF-kappaB p65、TNF-alpha和IL-1beta水平升高。RA以剂量依赖性方式改善了肾功能标志物，防止了组织损伤，抑制了ROS、MDA和NO，并下调了CPF中毒大鼠中的NF-kappaB p65、TNF-alpha和IL-1beta。RA降低了CPF给药大鼠中的Bax、caspase-3、氧化性DNA损伤及Keap1，增强了抗氧化酶和Bcl-2，并上调了Nrf2、HO-1和SIRT1。分子对接模拟揭示了RA与NF-kappaB、Keap1、HO-1和SIRT1的结合亲和力。总之，RA通过减轻氧化应激、炎症和凋亡，并上调SIRT1及Nrf2/HO-1信号通路，预防了CPF的肾毒性。
